notes: Identity, Garage, Master, Booking, Service, Organization, Marketplace and Communication have repository-backed partial verification. Duplicate stores/read-state representations are recorded as debt instead of silently canonized.

AuthSession stores current_context_id and session rotation/revocation state.
Contexts are selected only from contexts available to the current Account directly or through active context_members membership.
Effective authorization is calculated by backend capability allow/deny rules for the active Context.
AuthorizationPipeline performs a separate resource-ownership/access check after capability authorization.

verifiedInvariants: Order access is scoped to the current client, assigned master, STO, admin or owner through order_scope checks.
The safe work-order lifecycle is stage-gated by sto_workflows and records transitions separately.
A successful quality-control result requires the mandatory quality checks before progression.
Handover cannot be prepared as ready before quality has passed.
Client handover confirmation marks the order done, accepts the handover and advances the workflow toward completed.
Lifecycle child records are keyed by order_id and do not become independent ownership roots.

knownBoundaryDebt.target: Preserve the domain distinction ServiceRequest != RepairOrder even while the legacy physical store remains shared.
knownBoundaryDebt.migrationPolicy: Do not split the table merely for naming; introduce a contract/projection split only with complete call-site and regression coverage.

knownBoundaryDebt.migrationPolicy: Inventory action-by-action first; preserve legacy fallback until verified replacement coverage exists.

knownBoundaryDebt.target: Strangle one verified Service contract at a time; no new business actions should be added to the monolith.

dependencies: Service for accepted orders being scheduled
forbiddenWrites: RepairOrder lifecycle fields except through an explicit Service contract
verifiedInvariants: The canonical domain booking flow creates calendar_events and service_bookings transactionally.
booking.create checks overlap before insert and returns booking_conflict on collision.
booking.cancel scopes the booking to the current owner/organization and cancels both service_bookings and calendar_events in one transaction.
Booking and calendar writes require backend calendar.manageOwn or calendar.manageOrganization capability; availability/calendar reads require backend authorization.
Legacy api/booking_save.php is disabled with HTTP 410 and points callers to the unified flow.
Booking is not equivalent to RepairOrder.

knownBoundaryViolations.finding: Automatic schedule recovery directly updates orders.date and orders.time while mutating master_order_plans.
knownBoundaryViolations.target: Replace direct Service order write with an explicit Service scheduling contract after regression coverage exists.
knownBoundaryViolations.migrationPolicy: Do not delete or rewrite the legacy path until behavior and regression tests prove the replacement.

apis: legacy api/db.php chats.* / messages.* / notifications.* actions
dependencies: Platform domain_events for domain-event notification delivery
external messaging outbox/provider adapters for asynchronous fan-out
verifiedInvariants: Chat reads and message mutations require resource access through chat participants or legacy role/entity ownership checks.
Direct chat creation uses chat_participants and context-scoped chat identity to avoid one global direct-chat identity across contexts.
Message retries are idempotency-guarded by chat_id + from_role + client_message_id.
Chat attachments are stored outside public paths and are returned only after chat access verification.
Message read state is recorded in participant/read tables while legacy per-role unread/read columns are still maintained for compatibility.
The current Notifications page reads notification_center and marks notification_center rows read through capability-protected api/domain.php actions.

knownBoundaryDebt.finding: Two active notification stores coexist. Current UI reads notification_center, while many legacy business/chat flows write notifications through kareta_notification_insert.
knownBoundaryDebt.impact: A notification written only to notifications can be absent from the current Notifications page; read state can also diverge between the two stores.
knownBoundaryDebt.target: One canonical notification store/contract with adapters for legacy producers.
knownBoundaryDebt.migrationPolicy: Do not delete either table. Inventory every producer first, introduce one dual-write/outbox or migration adapter with idempotent keys, verify UI/read-state parity, then retire legacy reads/writes incrementally.

knownBoundaryDebt.finding: Unread/read state is represented both in chats/messages per-role columns and in chat_participants/chat_message_reads.
knownBoundaryDebt.impact: Partial writers can desynchronize unread counters and delivery/read labels.
knownBoundaryDebt.target: Select one canonical participant/message read model after all readers/writers are mapped; keep compatibility projection for legacy UI during migration.
knownBoundaryDebt.migrationPolicy: No column/table removal until parity tests prove counters and read receipts for client/master/STO/seller/admin.

knownBoundaryDebt.finding: Chat/message actions rely on Identity-aware resource access plus legacy role/entity fallbacks, but dispatcher actions are not uniformly capability-gated.
knownBoundaryDebt.target: Define explicit chat read/write capabilities while preserving participant/resource ownership checks.
knownBoundaryDebt.migrationPolicy: Add capability checks only after action-by-action compatibility and participant scenarios are covered.

knownBoundaryDebt.finding: Chats/messages and legacy notifications still route through api/db.php while notification_center uses api/domain.php.
knownBoundaryDebt.target: Move Communication commands/queries behind explicit owner contracts without creating another duplicate API layer.
